  • Descrever requisitos/stories/épicos de forma a endereçar as necessidades da demanda/iniciativa e facilitar o entendimento das equipes de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhado com equipes técnicas no refinamento das necessidades apontadas;
  • Conhecimento e atuação em modelos de desenvolvimento ágil (ex.: SCRUM, Kanban);
  • Atuado na definição e acompanhamento de métricas e objetivos de produtos (KPIs e OKRs);
  • Capacidade de comunicação com diversos níveis organizacionais.

Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Gerenciado portfólio de multi-projetos/demandas/iniciativas de diferentes tamanhos e prioridades;
  • Capacidade de realizar negociação de escopo em iniciativas multidisciplinares;
  • Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;
  • Habilidade em escrita técnica;
  • Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes financeiros.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:

Full Spectrum Search Group is a full-service healthcare recruiting agency specializing in post-acute leadership and healthcare administration.

We are seeking an AI Operations & Automation Lead to design and implement AI, automation, integrations, and internal tools across our recruiting, sales, and operational workflows.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can understand a business process, identify inefficiencies, and build practical technical solutions. Depending on the problem, the solution may involve AI, APIs, Python scripts, internal applications, MCP-based integrations, or traditional automation.

Experience in recruiting, staffing, business systems, solutions engineering, RevOps, product operations, or internal tools development is helpful but not required.

You will work closely with leadership and end users to understand how our team works, identify unnecessary manual effort, and build solutions that make our workflows faster, more accurate, and easier to use.

title: Brands Account Management Intern
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making fashion accessible to all. We use on-demand manufacturing technology to connect suppliers to our agile supply chain, reducing inventory waste and enabling us to deliver a variety of affordable products to customers around the world. From our global offices, we reach customers in 160 countries. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has nearly 17,000 employees operating from offices around the world, with its Brazil headquarters located in São Paulo.

Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Brands Account Management Intern will support the Brands team across the full seller journey, including Hunting, Incubation, and Account Management of Official Stores on SHEIN Marketplace.

The intern will work closely with the Brand Account Manager, supporting the acquisition and onboarding of new brands, seller operations, account follow-ups, campaign participation, product assortment, and initiatives focused on store growth and performance.

This role is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in e-commerce and marketplace operations, working directly with well-known brands and collaborating with different internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, Operations, and other business areas.

We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, analytical, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and priorities.

This role will be based in São Paulo.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the hunting and onboarding of new brands, including seller registration, collection of required information and documentation, and follow-up on pending steps;
  • Support the incubation of new Official Stores, helping sellers understand SHEIN processes, Seller Hub, campaigns, product publication, and operational routines;
  • Support the Account Manager in the day-to-day management of Official Stores, including seller communication and operational follow-ups;
  • Register, organize, and follow up on seller issues with internal teams, including updating the SHEIN Issue Tracker and other internal tracking tools;
  • Support sellers in increasing their product assortment and campaign participation, following up on product uploads and other growth initiatives;

REQUIREMENTS

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, International Relations, or related fields;
  • Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces, retail, or commercial/account management;
  • Good English communication skills;
  • Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, PowerPoint, and Word;
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership;
  • Proactive attitude, with willingness to learn and take initiative;
  • Fast learner, with ability to adapt to a dynamic environment;
  • Good communication and organizational skills;
  • Positive attitude and ability to work well in a multicultural team.
  • Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills;

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community, and all types of diversity.

title: Online Teacher - Whole Child Education | IWS Online School
description:
We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.

At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects, and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.

We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.

You may have many years of teaching experience.

You may have relatively little.

That is not the first thing we look at.

We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.

What is much harder to train is:

  • Genuine care for children
  • Empathy and emotional awareness
  • Positive energy and warmth
  • Strong character and responsibility
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • A real desire to make a difference in a child's life

The role

You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.

This includes:

  • Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons
  • Teaching your specialist subject effectively
  • Building strong relationships with students
  • Understanding each child as an individual
  • Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback
  • Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity
  • Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team
  • Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families
  • Participating in training and continuous professional development

Who we are looking for

We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.

What matters most is not simply what you teach.

It is how you make children feel while they are learning.

We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.

There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.

We take that responsibility seriously.

Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.

If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.

When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.

Not your best lesson.

The child.

title: Analista Comercial Pleno | Marketplace

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI), como Looker Platform ou soluções similares.
  • Vivência na construção de análises e dashboards para apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias que apoiem a produtividade e a otimização de rotinas comerciais.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Network Lifecycle Engineer
description:
Network Lifecycle Engineer- Brazil (Remote)

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Network Lifecycle Engineer to lead the planning, remediation, upgrade, migration, and modernization of enterprise network infrastructure.

The successful candidate will manage network hardware and software lifecycle activities, including end-of-life and end-of-support remediation, platform upgrades, technology migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead network infrastructure end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) remediation initiatives.
  • Assess existing network infrastructure and identify aging, unsupported, or vulnerable platforms.
  • Develop and execute hardware and software lifecycle plans.
  • Plan and coordinate network hardware replacement and platform migration activities.
  • Perform network OS upgrades, platform upgrades, and technology refreshes.
  • Develop migration plans with appropriate implementation, testing, and rollback strategies.
  • Coordinate network changes across data centers, campus, branch, and cloud environments.
  • Minimize service disruption during network migration and upgrade activities.
  • Collaborate with network, security, infrastructure, application, and operations teams.
  • Maintain accurate network inventory, lifecycle records, and technical documentation.
  • Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, and remediation activities.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and compliance requirements related to network infrastructure.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy network platforms and improve operational efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot issues during infrastructure upgrades and migrations.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations for network platform modernization.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in enterprise network engineering and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing EOL/EOS hardware and software remediation.
  • Strong knowledge of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network infrastructure.
  • Experience with network OS upgrades and hardware migrations.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, and network security.
  • Experience developing detailed migration and implementation plans.
  • Ability to perform impact analysis and develop rollback strategies.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience working with change-management and ITIL processes.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, or other enterprise networking platforms.
  • Experience with data center and cloud network modernization.
  • Knowledge of network automation using Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
  • Experience with vulnerability management and network compliance.
  • Experience managing large-scale infrastructure refresh or modernization programs.

description:

description:

O profissional liderará tecnicamente a arquitetura de agentes, integrações com modelos de linguagem, mecanismos de contexto e avaliação, transformando experimentação em capacidades robustas, seguras e escaláveis para o produto.

  • Definir estratégias de avaliação, testes automatizados e métricas para qualidade, segurança, confiabilidade e custo das respostas e ações dos agentes.
  • Conduzir decisões de arquitetura e revisões técnicas, orientando a evolução dos serviços do Smart Harness.
  • Mentorar profissionais do time e disseminar padrões de AI Engineering, backend e qualidade.
  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais, guardrails e padrões definidos durante o desenvolvimento.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Superior completo em tecnologia e afins
  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento backend e domínio avançado de Go.
  • Experiência em arquitetura de software distribuído, APIs Git, containers, testes automatizados, observabilidade e práticas de segurança.
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento assistido por IA, agentes, coding agents ou produtos baseados em LLMs.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

Conduzir discussões técnicas sobre inovações incrementais e radicais em conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais.

description:
Estamos chegando para revolucionar a indústria automotiva brasileira, trazendo veículos inovadores e de alta tecnologia, movidos por diversas fontes de energia, incluindo híbridos, elétricos e hidrogênio. Nossa fábrica em Iracemápolis (SP) será o centro de produção que impulsionará uma nova era do setor no Brasil, com potencial de produzir até 50 mil unidades em três anos, consolidando-se como um polo estratégico de exportação para a América Latina.

Fundada em 1984, a GWM é uma das maiores montadoras do mundo, líder no segmento de SUVs médios na China há 11 anos consecutivos e a quarta maior fabricante global de picapes médias, segmento no qual domina há 24 anos no mercado chinês. Com presença em mais de 60 países, um time global de cerca de 80 mil colaboradores e 10 centros de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento ao redor do mundo, a GWM se destaca pela inovação e pelo compromisso com a mobilidade do futuro.

Nosso propósito é construir um futuro sustentável e inteligente, guiado pela nossa filosofia GIFT - Green Intelligent Future Technology (Tecnologia Inteligente e Sustentável do Futuro). Nossos valores essenciais são: inovação, transformação, colaboração, integridade e transparência, sempre combatendo a corrupção e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho ético e inspirador.

Com um investimento de mais de R$ 10 bilhões no Brasil, estamos prontos para redefinir os rumos da mobilidade no país. Se você quer fazer parte dessa jornada, venha construir o futuro da indústria automotiva com a GWM!

Hello, tomorrow!

Gerente de Comércio Exterior | Comex

Gerente de Comércio Exterior será responsável por liderar e supervisionar todas as operações de importação relacionadas a peças e componentes para manufatura automotiva, assegurando conformidade com a legislação aduaneira brasileira, eficiência nos processos de desembaraço e alinhamento contínuo com as necessidades produtivas da fábrica. A posição terá foco em operações Part-by-Part, CKD/SKD e importações pontuais de equipamentos industriais, atuando como principal interface com despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga e órgãos reguladores.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e coordenar operações de desembaraço aduaneiro de sistemas, subsistemas e componentes automotivos (produção e/ou peças de reposição);
  • Supervisionar processos de importação Part-by-Part e CKD, garantindo continuidade produtiva e compliance regulatório;
  • Administrar operações CKD, incluindo classificação fiscal, análise documental e condução dos procedimentos aduaneiros;
  • Coordenar importações ocasionais de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Atuar como ponto focal junto a despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga e autoridades governamentais;
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação de importação (fatura comercial, packing list, certificados, entre outros);
  • Assegurar correta classificação tarifária (NCM/HS), incluindo aplicação e gestão de Ex-Tarifário quando aplicável;
  • Monitorar processos aduaneiros, prazos de liberação e riscos operacionais, atuando preventivamente para mitigar atrasos;
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação aduaneira brasileira e políticas internas de compliance;
  • Suportar auditorias, fiscalizações e esclarecimentos junto à Receita Federal e demais órgãos anuentes;
  • Atuar em estreita colaboração com Produção, Logística, Compras e Finanças para garantir alinhamento entre operações de importação e planejamento fabril.

Requisistos:

  • Graduação em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (mandatório);
  • Experiência prévia em indústria automotiva e em posições de liderança em Comex ou Logística;
  • Sólido conhecimento em Comércio Exterior e legislação aduaneira brasileira, incluindo classificação fiscal (NCM/HS), valoração aduaneira e regimes especiais (como Ex-Tarifário);
  • Experiência em importação de peças automotivas (CIF/FOB), com domínio dos modelos SKD, CKD e Part-by-Part, atuando junto a despachantes, agentes de carga e órgãos reguladores;
  • Vivência na gestão de operações complexas vinculadas à produção fabril, incluindo importação de equipamentos industriais, gestão de canal vermelho e otimização de custos logísticos e armazenagem;
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão simultânea de múltiplos processos sob prazos críticos, com forte perfil analítico, organização, negociação e comunicação.

title: Coordenador de Meio Ambiente
description:
A Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo, com um portfólio icônico de marcas de fragrâncias, cosméticos, cuidados com a pele e cuidados com o corpo. Na Coty, celebramos e cultivamos uma cultura de gentileza. Acreditamos que a beleza reside na diversidade e estamos empenhados em continuar a construir um ambiente onde todos os talentos brilham, pois valorizamos as contribuições únicas que cada indivíduo traz para a nossa equipe. E como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão, todos os perfis são bem-vindos.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Coordenar a gestão ambiental da unidade, assegurando a operação adequada dos sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes, a gestão de resíduos sólidos e o atendimento aos requisitos legais, corporativos e demais requisitos aplicáveis;
  • Implementar, manter e desenvolver o Sistema de Gestão Ambiental da fábrica, garantindo o cumprimento e a disseminação da Política Ambiental corporativa, dos procedimentos internos e das diretrizes de sustentabilidade;
  • Garantir a eficiência operacional, a conformidade ambiental e a melhoria contínua dos processos sob sua responsabilidade, atuando na prevenção de impactos ambientais, na redução de perdas e na gestão responsável dos recursos naturais.
  • Garantir os requisitos de Saúde e Segurança, assegurando o cumprimento das ferramentas de HSE, a prevenção de riscos, a participação em programas, auditorias e rotinas de segurança e o desdobramento das diretrizes para a equipe;
  • Gerir a equipe de Meio Ambiente, incluindo jornada, férias, capacitação, integração, comunicação, feedbacks, avaliação de desempenho, desenvolvimento e engajamento;
  • Conduzir a gestão e a rotina da área, assegurando padronização, cumprimento de procedimentos, registros, 5S, metas, KPIs, planos de ação, auditorias, análises críticas e tratamento de desvios e não conformidades;
  • Garantir a operação da ETA e ETE, assegurando desempenho e conformidade dos sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes, com acompanhamento dos parâmetros legais e operacionais, eficiência, consumo de químicos, geração de lodo e qualidade dos processos;
  • Assegurar a manutenção e confiabilidade dos ativos ambientais, garantindo registro e tratamento de anomalias, acompanhamento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas junto à Manutenção, Utilidades e Engenharia e desenvolvimento de melhorias técnicas e projetos;
  • Gerir os processos de resíduos, assegurando segregação, armazenamento, movimentação, transporte, destinação e rastreabilidade, incluindo gestão de prestadores e atendimento aos requisitos legais;
  • Administrar custos e orçamento da área, elaborando e acompanhando o orçamento, controlando custos de ETA, ETE, resíduos, monitoramentos, serviços e insumos, além de gerir compras, contratos, estoques e oportunidades de redução de custos;
  • Assegurar os requisitos de Qualidade aplicáveis à área, incluindo BPF, gestão de reagentes, calibração e manutenção de instrumentos, cumprimento dos planos analíticos, análise de resultados e tratamento de desvios;
  • Manter e desenvolver o Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, abrangendo aspectos e impactos, controles operacionais, procedimentos, monitoramentos e indicadores de desempenho ambiental;
  • Assegurar a conformidade legal ambiental, garantindo identificação e atendimento da legislação, gestão de licenças, autorizações, condicionantes e obrigações, incluindo reportes aos órgãos competentes;
  • Planejar e acompanhar os monitoramentos ambientais, garantindo execução e análise dos controles de águas, efluentes, resíduos, emissões, ruído e demais aspectos aplicáveis, em conformidade com requisitos legais e internos;
  • Promover comunicação e capacitação ambiental, por meio de treinamentos, campanhas, orientações e ações de conscientização para colaboradores e terceiros;
  • Garantir a gestão documental ambiental, assegurando controle, atualização, rastreabilidade e disponibilidade de registros, licenças, certificados, laudos, relatórios, manifestos e demais documentos ambientais;
  • Assegurar a preparação e resposta a emergências ambientais, mantendo planos, cenários, recursos, procedimentos, treinamentos e simulados para vazamentos, derramamentos e demais ocorrências;
  • Promover melhoria contínua e sustentabilidade, implementando projetos para redução do consumo de água, energia, químicos e recursos naturais, redução de resíduos e efluentes, aumento da reutilização e reciclagem e melhoria da eficiência ambiental.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação completa em Eng. Ambiental, Eng. Química, Eng.Civil, Química, Biologia, Tecnólogo Ambiental/Químico/Saneamento e afins.
  • Experiência de 4 a 5 anos
  • Inglês avançado será um diferencial
  • CREA ou CRQ ativo
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • Conhecimento em SAP
  • Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores, metas, KPIs e planos de ação;
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de 5S, melhoria contínua e sustentabilidade.
  • Experiência com liderança e desenvolvimento de equipe;
  • Senso de urgência e foco em resultados;
  • Análise crítica e visão sistêmica;

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Assistência Médica – Unimed
  • Assistência Odontológica – Unimed Odonto
  • Vale Transporte/Fretado ou Estacionamento
  • Vale Alimentação - Ifood Benefícios
  • Refeição na empresa
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Seguro Acidentes Pessoais Coletivo (opcional)
  • Wellhub
  • Desconto em compras de produtos Coty
  • Birthday off
  • Licença Parental Estendida 180 dias para mães e pais

title: Impulsiona CTC - Banco de talentos Programa de estágio
description:
O futuro está no campo. Venha construí-lo com a gente!

O CTC é líder global em ciência da cana-de-açúcar e referência em inovação para o agronegócio. Há mais de 50 anos, desenvolvemos soluções que ampliam a produtividade, a competitividade e a sustentabilidade do setor bioenergético.

Movidos pela nossa Visão 2040, trabalhamos para impulsionar uma nova era para o agronegócio, combinando ciência, tecnologia e inovação para dobrar a produtividade dos canaviais brasileiros e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável e descarbonizado.

E para seguir avançando nessa jornada, buscamos jovens estagiários(as) que queiram construir sua carreira e participar da história do CTC.

Temos vagas para diferentes formações. Possui interesse em estagiar no CTC? Se inscreva e participe de processos seletivos futuros.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO CTC?

Aqui acreditamos que grandes resultados são construídos por pessoas que colaboram, assumem protagonismo, compartilham conhecimento e evoluem continuamente. Valorizamos a construção coletiva, o aprendizado constante e a capacidade de transformar desafios em soluções que geram valor para nossos clientes e para o setor.

Tudo isso em um ambiente onde cada pessoa encontra espaço para contribuir, crescer e gerar impacto, porque acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão ampliam perspectivas e fortalecem nossas soluções.

Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios que apoia sua saúde, crescimento profissional e bem-estar:

  • Bolsa estágio
  • Plano médico
  • Restaurante no local e transporte conforme política vigente.
  • Participação no Impulsiona CTC- Programa de estágio que te proporcionará desenvolvimento por meio de treinamentos, projetos e prática!

Mais do que desenvolver ciência e tecnologia, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impacto real. Aqui, seu trabalho contribuirá para transformar conhecimento em soluções que chegam ao campo e ajudam a enfrentar alguns dos maiores desafios do agronegócio e da sustentabilidade.

title: Key Account Manager (E-commerce)

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno (Precificação)
description:
A posição está alocada no PMO da Engenharia e tem como principal objetivo realizar a precificação de projetos de engenharia, apoiando a área na estimativa de custos antes dos processos de contratação. O profissional será responsável por analisar listas de materiais, validar quantitativos, elaborar orçamentos, emitir relatórios de custos (PPU, DFP, Curva ABC), manter bases de dados de custos e apoiar a tomada de decisão em projetos.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a precificação de projetos de engenharia, analisando listas de materiais, custos diretos e indiretos, composições de custos, preços de mercado e indicadores econômicos.
  • Avaliar e revisar listas de materiais, verificando quantitativos, especificações técnicas, unidades de medida e aderência aos padrões corporativos.
  • Elaborar estudos de custos para apoiar processos de contratação, negociações com fornecedores, validação de propostas comerciais e tomada de decisão.
  • Administrar e manter atualizadas as bases de dados de custos, incluindo materiais, mão de obra, equipamentos, encargos sociais e índices de mercado.
  • Pesquisar e consolidar referências de preços em contratos anteriores, cotações de fornecedores, SAP, bases públicas e demais fontes corporativas.
  • Emitir e analisar relatórios de custos, como PPU, DFP, Curva ABC e demais documentos utilizados em processos de contratação.
  • Apoiar equipes de Engenharia, Construção e Gestão de Projetos na análise de orçamentos, definição de escopos e avaliação da viabilidade econômica dos projetos.
  • Realizar análises comparativas entre valores orçados, contratados e executados, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Participar da revisão e melhoria contínua de processos, procedimentos e metodologias relacionadas à gestão de custos e orçamentação.
  • Desenvolver e manter metodologias de precificação, critérios de BDI e indicadores de desempenho e assertividade orçamentária.
  • Gerenciar a governança e a integridade das informações de custos entre sistemas corporativos, garantindo rastreabilidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar como administrador funcional dos sistemas de precificação, realizando suporte, configuração de permissões e validação de funcionalidades.
  • Promover iniciativas de automação, integração de dados e inteligência de mercado, buscando maior eficiência nos processos de gestão de custos e integração com sistemas como SAP e ferramentas analíticas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em gestão de custos e orçamento de projetos de engenharia.
  • Conhecimento em elaboração e análise de composições de custos e precificação.
  • Conhecimento de BDI, DFP e PPU.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado.
  • Conhecimento em SAP.
  • Experiência com softwares de precificação e orçamentação.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento no sistema SEOBRA.
  • Experiência com Oracle Primavera Cloud.
  • Conhecimento de gestão e integração de dados aplicados a custos e projetos.
  • Vivência em projetos de engenharia, construção, montagem industrial ou infraestrutura.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência na estruturação e administração de bases corporativas de custos.
  • Atuação com automação de processos, inteligência de mercado e integração de sistema.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de desempenho e metodologias de controle orçamentário.

title: Treasury Manager LATAM
description:
About the Role

At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking a Treasury Manager LATAM to lead and support key treasury activities across the region. This role is responsible for cash management, banking relationships, foreign exchange (FX) and hedging activities, financial risk analysis, treasury reporting, and compliance initiatives. The position will play a critical role in optimizing liquidity, supporting strategic business initiatives, managing financial risks, and ensuring effective treasury operations across multiple LATAM countries.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Legal, SBS, and external banking partners, contributing to business growth through sound treasury practices, process improvements, and strategic projects, including acquisitions, organizational transformations, and system enhancements.

São Paulo/SP (Rochaverá Corporate Towers) | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

Treasury / Cash Management

Oversees the preparation of the region's daily cash position and execute cash transfers, borrowing and investment transactions.

Compile monthly cash forecast for the region and analyze differences to forecast.

Review the region's account structure, proposing and implementing changes to banking partners, structures, services and controls.

Utilize global treasury systems and internal finance programs.

Participates in strategic projects, including transformation efforts, mergers and acquisitions, legal entity rationalizations, TMS system upgrades, etc.

Identify cash repatriation opportunities and strategies.

Manage intercompany loan transactions.

Maintain powers of attorney and portal access in compliance with Banking Authority Resolution requirements.

Accounting, Compliance and Reporting Responsibilities

Manage TMS system accounting.

Coordinate the monthly compilation and distribution of regional treasury reporting.

Oversee the collection of information to comply with internal and external audit requests.

Support Know Your Customer (KYC) requests from banking partners.

Foreign Exchange and Interest

Identify, quantify, and monitor regional net foreign currency exposures for the LATAM region and propose solutions to mitigate such risk.

Execute and confirm FX transactions monthly to settle cross-currency exposures and funding within the region.

Monitor interest rate exposure and recommend risk mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder and Banking Relationship Management

Develop, cultivate, and manage relationships with banks, vendors, and internal stakeholders, including Tax, Legal, SBS, Accounting, and Finance teams.

Lead projects that involve coordinating regional and cross-functional teams.

Insurance Support

Support global insurance activities within the LATAM region.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

MBA, Postgraduate Degree, or equivalent advanced qualification in Finance, Treasury, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

Knowledge & Experience

5 to 10 years of experience in a finance-related role, including at least 3 years of Treasury experience.

Fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish (written and spoken).

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong accounting knowledge.

Experience with Oracle ERP, OneStream, and Reval Treasury Management System (TMS).

Experience working with cultural, regulatory, and business differences between Latin America and the United States.

Experience working in cross-functional environments and supporting process improvement initiatives.

Strong leadership, problem-solving, critical-thinking, analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of capital markets, corporate banking, cash management products and services, and foreign exchange markets.

International experience in a Finance or Treasury-related role.

Experience supporting treasury operations across multiple LATAM countries.

Experience participating in mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or treasury transformation initiatives.

Why Sherwin-Williams?

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to support your health and well-being.

In your career... through learning opportunities, professional development, and growth within a global organization.

In your future... by providing meaningful work and the opportunity to make a lasting impact in a company committed to innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

description:

title: Gerente de Área
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída.

Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações.

Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br.

Posição: Gerente de Área Vendas - São Paulo Interior

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em indústria varejo alimentar;
  • Conhecimento amplo no atendimento de clientes no canal varejo, atacado e distribuidores de pequeno e médio porte;
  • Habilidade em gestão de indicadores, análise de informações e tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Capacidade para desenvolver campanhas comerciais e planos de negócio junto aos clientes;
  • Liderança para acompanhar equipes de Empresários Representantes Comerciais e ações de marketing;
  • Estruturação de equipes (montagem e desenvolvimento de equipes);
  • Importante ter atuado profissionalmente na região de Bauru no interior do estado de São Paulo;
  • Residir na cidade de Bauru/SP.

Principais desafios:

Monitorar performance de produtos e garantir execução no PDV;

Acompanhar lojas, estoques e distribuição;

Ativar materiais de PDV conforme prioridades do ciclo comercial;

Montar e desenvolver equipe de Empresários Representantes Comerciais.

title: Project Manager
description:
The project is part of a next-generation SaaS technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry, processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale, high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Team Management & People Development

  • Manage and support the engineering team ±20 people in LATAM (incl. but not only Brazil) through regular 1:1 meetings.
  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain a healthy and productive team environment.
  • Support engineers in their professional development and career growth.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
  • Identify performance issues early and create improvement plans when necessary.
  • Support employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Handle and help resolve conflicts within the team.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams.
  • Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance.
  • Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.
  • Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs.
  • Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges.
  • Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues.
  • Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company.
  • Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client.
  • Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients.
  • Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally.
  • Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation.
  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.
  • Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project.
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong ownership and proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Hospitality Implementation Coordinator – Sales & Catering Technology

Location: Brazil — Remote

Employment type: Full-time Contractor

English level: Advanced/Fluent

About the role

We are seeking Hospitality Implementation Coordinators to support the global rollout of a Sales & Catering platform across a large portfolio of hotel properties.

This is a hospitality implementation and project coordination role, not a technical support position. Each coordinator will manage a portfolio of hotels and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the implementation process.

The role is responsible for ensuring that hotel information is collected accurately, implementation activities remain on schedule, required training is completed, and issues are communicated to the appropriate teams. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with hotel properties, regional commercial stakeholders, corporate support teams, external vendors and technical resources.

Hospitality industry experience is the primary requirement. Technical experience is valuable but secondary.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary implementation contact for assigned hotel properties.
  • Coordinate hotel-level activities for the rollout of a Sales & Catering platform.
  • Guide properties through implementation milestones, readiness requirements and deployment gates.
  • Ensure required hotel data is accurately gathered, mapped, validated and entered into implementation workbooks and systems of record.
  • Follow up on missing information, corrections and data discrepancies.
  • Track implementation progress, critical deadlines and hotel activation status.
  • Identify delays and risks, take appropriate follow-up action and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Verify that required e-learning modules and training activities are completed before hotels advance to the next implementation phase.
  • Follow up with hotels that are behind schedule or have not completed required activities.
  • Coordinate between hotel properties, corporate support teams, regional commercial leads, external vendors and technical resources.
  • Facilitate consultation calls to ensure that platform configurations reflect each hotel's operational and commercial needs.
  • Validate required participation agreements, billing arrangements and other property-level deployment requirements.
  • Maintain accurate implementation records, dashboards and status reports.
  • Provide regional stakeholders and program leadership with clear updates on implementation progress.
  • Support early-adopter initiatives and encourage hotels to begin implementation ahead of mandatory deadlines.
  • Help ensure consistent communication and execution across multiple implementation workstreams and hotel properties.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Strong understanding of hotel operations and the impact that technology changes can have on property teams.
  • Experience working in or closely with hotel sales, catering, groups, events or commercial teams.
  • Advanced or fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project coordination, organization and timeline-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple hotel properties, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Ability to motivate stakeholders, reinforce deadlines and follow up consistently without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving implementation risks.
  • Emotional intelligence, self-awareness and cultural sensitivity.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, implementation workbooks, dashboards, presentations and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and internationally distributed team.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Delphi, Delphi FDC, Amadeus Sales & Event Management or another hotel Sales & Catering platform.
  • Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) or other hotel technology implementations.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Previous involvement in hotel technology rollouts, system migrations, hotel openings or property conversions.
  • Experience supporting implementations across multiple hotel properties or regions.
  • Experience coordinating hotel teams, vendors and technical resources.
  • University degree in hospitality, business, project management or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate understands hotel operations and has experience working with hotel sales, catering, groups or events teams. They recognize the operational disruption that a new system can create and can guide hotel teams through change with empathy, organization and accountability.

They are comfortable managing deadlines, following up persistently, maintaining accurate records and communicating with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. They do not need to be a technical specialist, but they should be confident working alongside technical teams and learning hotel technology platforms.

This role does not include

  • Technical product support or software troubleshooting.
  • Software development or system engineering.
  • Product enhancement or feature-request management.
  • Product testing or quality assurance.
  • Ownership of software defects or technical product issues.

title: E-commerce Sales manager- Brazil
description:
We are looking for a results-oriented E-commerce Sales Manager to oversee and grow EZVIZ's online sales channels in Brazil. You will be responsible for defining and executing the commercial strategy for major marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon) and local retail ecosystems (Magalu, Americanas, Via/Casas Bahia), ensuring brand consistency and sales targets achievement.

Responsibilities:

  • Marketplace Management: Direct management of Mercado Livre (Official Store) and Amazon Seller Central. Monitor KPIs such as conversion rates, traffic, and ROI.

  • Multi-Channel Expansion: Oversee presence in local "3P" marketplaces such as Magalu, Americanas, and Shopee, optimizing product assortment for each platform.

  • Data Analysis: Provide detailed weekly and monthly reports on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity to regional HQ.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Trade, or related fields.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of proven experience in E-commerce sales within the Brazilian market, preferably in the Consumer Electronics, Tech, or Home Security industry.

  • Languages: Native Portuguese and Professional English (Daily communication with HQ in English/Chinese).
  • Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, proactive mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced global environment.

title: Mainframe Solution Architect - Remote
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role Purpose

Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the mainframe platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Design
  • Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex mainframe applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
  • Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, approved platforms, reusable patterns and target-state roadmaps.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance
  • Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.
  • Set coding, API, integration, logging, configuration, testing and deployment standards.
  • Run architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical risk assessments and PoC evaluations. Security, Reliability & Performance
  • Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
  • Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
  • Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.

Technology Focus — Mainframe

  • Design, develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 batch and online components within agreed standards.
  • Optimize batch windows, DB2 access paths and resource consumption to protect service levels.
  • Support mainframe modernization, API exposure and integration with distributed and cloud platforms.

Required Technical Competencies

  • COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2 and z/OS utilities; batch and online program design and optimization.
  • Mainframe application architecture, modularization, API enablement and modernization/coexistence patterns.
  • Data & Integration DB2 and VSAM data design, SQL tuning, file handling, data conversion, integrity and reconciliation.
  • Platform & DevOps z/OS operations, scheduling, change management, environment promotion and mainframe-to-distributed integration.
  • Quality & Operations Unit and regression testing, batch cycle validation, performance and MIPS optimization, defect RCA.

title: General Manager, Brazil
description:
What you'll do

As the General Manager for Brazil, you will have full P&L ownership of ANTA's Brazil business, with a primary focus on market development, business expansion, and sustainable growth, with a strong emphasis on the wholesale channel.

You will lead the development of the Brazil market from an early-stage business, proactively identify and develop key commercial opportunities, build a strong local customer and distribution network, and establish the organizational and operational foundation required for long-term growth.

This is a highly entrepreneurial and hands-on role. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, make things happen with limited resources, and demonstrate strong commercial drive, ownership, and execution capability.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the overall Brazil business and deliver annual business objectives, including sales, gross margin, profitability, inventory, cash flow, and market expansion targets.
  • Develop and execute the Brazil business strategy and annual operating plan, establishing a clear path from market entry to scalable and sustainable growth.
  • Lead wholesale business development, proactively identify, acquire, and develop key distributors, retailers, key accounts, and other commercial partners.
  • Drive market expansion by actively identifying new customers, channels, territories, and business opportunities, and continuously growing ANTA's market presence in Brazil.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and business partners, leading commercial negotiations and ensuring strong execution.
  • Develop retail and other relevant sales channels where appropriate, while building an efficient and sustainable multi-channel business model.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-changing and resource-constrained environment, proactively solving problems, leveraging internal and external resources, and driving key initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Build and develop the local organization and operating infrastructure across key functions, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Human Resources.
  • Take full ownership of business budgeting, forecasting, inventory, cash flow, and financial performance, and continuously drive improvements in business results.
  • Recruit, develop, motivate, and lead a high-performing local team, building a strong ownership-driven and results-oriented culture.
  • Provide regular updates to Group and headquarters on business performance, market trends, competitive intelligence, key customers, and major business opportunities, together with clear recommendations.
  • Ensure the Brazil business operates in full compliance with local laws, regulations, and company policies, while effectively managing business and operational risks.
  • Undertake other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by Management from time to time.

What you'll bring

  • Strong commercial mindset with a proven entrepreneurial and hunter mentality.
  • Highly proactive, hands-on, and resourceful, with the ability to build a business with limited resources and a high degree of autonomy.
  • Strong wholesale business development capabilities, with a proven ability to identify, approach, negotiate with, and develop key customers and commercial partners.
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with excellent execution capability and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian market, customers, and competitive landscape.
  • Passion for sports is a must.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Management, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • 15+ years of experience in business management, commercial leadership, sales leadership, or general management.
  • Strong and proven experience in wholesale business, including distributor, retailer, key account, or channel development.
  • Proven track record of full P&L ownership and managing overall business performance.
  • Hands-on experience developing business and commercial networks in Brazil.
  • Experience in retail, sporting goods, footwear/apparel, or other consumer industries is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience building a business, market, or organization from the ground up, particularly in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong track record of delivering business growth through active market development and customer acquisition.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Mandarin Chinese is a plus.

Travel

This role is based in Brazil and requires regular travel within Brazil to develop customers, visit business partners, support market expansion, and oversee local operations. Occasional travel to ANTA Group's global headquarters may also be required.

title: Inside Sales & Customer Growth Manager
description:
Location: São Paulo - SP. (Regional scope)

Reports to: Regional Director Brazil & Colombia

Team: Directly manages analysts/executors across four functions (no intermediate leads at this stage), 10 HCs

About the Role

We are looking for a Head Manager of Inside Sales & Customer Growth to lead and structure our Inside Sales operation. This position comes with a clear mission: to become the engine of scalable, replicable, and intelligent customer base growth.

This role currently oversees four distinct functions — inbound lead conversion (hunting), churn account reactivation, remote servicing of small accounts, and sales support — with direct management of each team member.

Mission

Drive scalable, replicable, and intelligent growth of the customer base across the region by directly managing and standardizing the operations of lead conversion, account reactivation, remote account servicing, and commercial support — freeing up the Key Account Management (KAM) team to focus on strategic accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Hunting (Inbound Lead Conversion)

  • Own the process for receiving and converting leads generated through the portal
  • Drive speed-to-lead and improve conversion rate through process discipline and coaching
  • Define and monitor SLAs for response time and follow-up

Churn Reactivation

  • Lead efforts to reactivate churned accounts and recover lost revenue
  • Build a systematic, repeatable approach to identifying and prioritizing reactivation opportunities

Small Accounts (Remote Servicing)

  • Manage remote coverage of small accounts that do not warrant a dedicated KAM
  • Ensure service quality and account growth through efficient, scalable processes

Sales Support

  • Provide operational support to the broader commercial team
  • Ensure fast turnaround and high satisfaction from internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Design and standardize playbooks and processes across all four functions, built to be replicable across countries (Brazil & Colombia)
  • Directly manage, coach, and develop the individuals executing each function
  • Track and report on performance metrics across all four workstreams
  • Partner closely with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and the broader Commercial team to align on lead flow, account handoffs, and shared goals

Success Metrics (6–12 months)

  • Growth in active customer base (%)
  • Standardized, documented processes across all four functions, replicable across countries
  • Improved conversion rate (hunting) and reactivation rate (churn)
  • Team development plan in place, with a clear path toward a squad-lead structure as the operation scales

What We're Looking For

Industry Experience

  • Solid experience in the travel & tourism industry, ideally within online travel platforms (OTAs), booking marketplaces, or tour/travel operators
  • Understanding of how travel distribution works — lead sources, booking cycles, seasonality, and the relationship dynamics between platforms, operators, and agents

Functional / Technical

  • Strong analytical capability — comfortable reading funnel data, conversion metrics, and churn/cohort analysis
  • Process-oriented mindset, with experience designing or improving operational playbooks

Leadership

  • People management experience, ideally across diverse functions or a fast-changing environment
  • Execution discipline — able to drive rhythm, accountability, and results
  • Strong negotiation and cross-functional influence skills — this role depends heavily on alignment with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and Sales

Behavioral

  • Builder mindset — comfortable structuring a function from the ground up in a lean, still-forming regional operation
  • Autonomy and comfort with ambiguity
  • Cultural adaptability, with an eye toward managing teams across multiple countries as the role expands

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Customer Growth roles
  • Experience operating in a regional or multi-country context
  • Portuguese, Spanish and English fluency, given the Brazil & Colombia scope

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the Job

We're building Brazil's largest B2B credit infrastructure, and we're looking for a Collections Analyst who is a true negotiation master to play a key role in that journey. You'll be on the front line of debt recovery, negotiating directly — and skillfully — with a wide range of profiles, from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies, always finding the angle that gets deals done while building the kind of trust that strengthens Credix's relationships with its clients. But this role goes beyond collecting: you'll think strategically, analyzing delinquency data, surfacing actionable insights, and helping shape the future of our automation-first collections model. If you're a natural dealmaker, a decisive owner, a clear communicator, and thrive in a dynamic credit landscape, this is the role for you.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers, monitoring payments and driving collection negotiations with the skill of a true dealmaker — efficient, respectful, and always finding a path to resolution.
  • Monitor and control accounts receivable, ensuring financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Use Excel and SQL to analyze data, track key performance indicators, and manage the collections portfolio. Support the automation of operational processes using Python (preferred) to improve efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Prioritize competing demands and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure an excellent customer experience and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned client wallet, negotiating like a true master dealmaker over phone and messaging and recovering outstanding debts across varied customer profiles — from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies.
  • Take ownership of decisions and proactively align with cross-functional teams to solve collection challenges.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions.
  • Analyze delinquency data to generate actionable insights that improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and use tools like Python and SQL to build scripts that improve process efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automated workflows to streamline collections processes.
  • Conduct quality audits of external collection agencies, providing feedback to improve recovery rates.
  • Track performance against KPIs, including recoveries per OKR/Collections Policy and percentage of automated workflows implemented.

What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our São Paulo office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, learn, and grow together.

In addition, we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation, where curiosity is encouraged.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Equity stock options plan.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Clear growth opportunities within collections and operations.
  • Team off-sites focused on collaboration, fun, and shared experiences.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar obrigações contratuais, assegurando aderência aos requisitos de HSE, compliance e controles internos.
  • Apoiar os processos de venda e receita de óleo e gás, incluindo faturamento e reconciliações entre produção e vendas.

  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar claims, garantindo documentação completa, rastreabilidade e adequado histórico de auditoria.

  • Preparar, coordenar e registrar processos de chartering, incluindo aprovações internas e externas, emissão de autorizações e certificados, registros SAMA e controle documental.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com equipes de Shipping & Maritime, EBNs parceiros e Commercial Operations (ComOps), além de interfaces externas, incluindo a ANTAQ.
  • Apoiar e executar processos relacionados a coleta e validação de dados e Work Instructions (WI), fluxos de pagamentos, custos e apropriações, trilhas de auditoria para claims.
  • Relatórios operacionais semanais, pacotes mensais de KPIs e custos;
  • Registro consolidado e atualizado de claims e respectivos status;

Requisitos:

  • Desejável experiência com Excel / VBA; Power BI; SAP — RtP, MM e FI

Competências

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Proatividade.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Senso de responsabilidade.
  • Trabalho em equipe.

title: Pesquisador - Graduado - Bosch - Nozzle process visualization - Inova Talento - IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Inova Talentos tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Bosch Curitiba está em busca de um profissional para atuar em um projeto estratégico de inovação voltado à digitalização e ao monitoramento do processo de fabricação de bicos injetores diesel. A iniciativa envolve integração de dados de medição, definição de limites estatísticos e desenvolvimento de dashboards para acompanhamento em tempo real. O profissional contribuirá para a criação de uma solução capaz de ampliar a rastreabilidade, antecipar desvios e apoiar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, fortalecendo a manufatura digital e os conceitos de Indústria 4.0.

Projeto: Nozzle process visualization

Formação Acadêmica:

Bolsista Graduado em Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica), Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia

Idioma: Inglês – intermediário / avançado

  • Mapear as operações-chave do processo de fabricação;
  • Definir, junto ao time técnico, as estratégias de conectividade e integração dos diferentes equipamentos;
  • Apoiar, em conjunto com a área de TI, a definição do funcionamento e dos requisitos da solução de software;
  • Definir limites de controle e reação para as principais características do processo;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o plano do projeto, incluindo cronograma, custos, etapas e entregas;
  • Definir indicadores para acompanhamento da performance e dos resultados;
  • Implementar e validar a solução desenvolvida;
  • Realizar o treinamento da equipe do chão de fábrica para utilização da nova solução.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Domínio prático de conceitos estatísticos aplicados à manufatura, incluindo capabilidade de processo (Cp e Cpk) e limites de controle superior e inferior;
  • Conhecimento em processos de usinagem e manufatura;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas e instrumentos de medição, como paquímetro, micrômetro e máquina de medição por coordenadas (CMM);
  • Conhecimento básico sobre funcionamento e estrutura de bancos de dados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados, como Power BI;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, ou métodos tradicionais de gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento e controle de tarefas.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias estruturadas para solução de problemas complexos no ambiente industrial, como Shainin, Funnel Problem Solving ou Lean Six Sigma;
  • Certificação Lean Six Sigma Green Belt ou Black Belt será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Mudanças (Change Management);
  • Habilidade para apoiar a transição de equipes operacionais e de supervisão de um modelo de controle reativo para uma abordagem preditiva e digital.

Soft Skills:

  • Autonomia;
  • Liderança;
  • Autogestão.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Soamer - PowerFab Soamer - Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em iniciativas de automação industrial, otimização de processos e implantação de melhorias operacionais com base em metodologias enxutas e sistemas de gestão integrados. O projeto também prevê o uso de tecnologia e inovação para reduzir o lead time e fortalecer a competitividade da empresa no setor automotivo.

Se você busca aplicar seus conhecimentos em um ambiente industrial dinâmico, com foco em inovação, produtividade e impacto real nos resultados, essa vaga é para você.

Doutorado em Engenharia ou área correlata.

  • Estudar os processos produtivos, desenvolver fornecedores para otimização das etapas de polimento, solda e corte, e apoiar na implementação de células de trabalho integradas, que consolidem múltiplas operações por meio da utilização de braços robóticos.;

title: HR Business Partner Specialist
description:
E aí, tudo azul por aí?

A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de HRBP Especialista, alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada.

O seu papel por aqui:

Como Especialista de HRBP, você será o braço direito estratégico das lideranças das nossas áreas mais core e aceleradas: Tecnologia, Produto, Finance e Growth. Você não será apenas uma ponte com o RH, mas sim uma pessoa parceira de negócios que entende as dores, antecipa problemas e desenha soluções para apoiar o crescimento dessas estruturas.

O que você vai encarar no dia a dia:

  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a lideranças de Tech, Product, Finance e Revenue, alinhando a estratégia de pessoas aos objetivos de negócio.
