title: Subject Matter Expert — Digital Corporate
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Brazil's corporate compliance landscape — eSocial, SPED, and a fast-changing tax regime — makes local corporate digitalisation materially different from a global template rollout.

This SME is the on-the-ground domain authority for Digital Corporate at the Curitiba site, covering local Finance, Workforce/HR, Legal & Compliance, and Property Management processes, and acting as the bridge between the Brazil site's corporate function leads and the global Digital Corporate platform teams — including the ERP Centre of Excellence (SAP COE, CE SAP, Buses MFG and Penta Manufacturing system owners), Brand Management/Communications/CSR, and Strategy & Portfolio Management.

The role demands someone who has sat inside a Brazilian corporate function, understands local statutory reporting obligations, and can translate that context into digital solution requirements the global platform team can build against.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead current-state discovery across Finance (FP&A, controlling, reporting), Workforce/HR, Legal, Compliance and Property Management processes at the Brazil site — facilitated directly with local corporate stakeholders in Portuguese.
  • Act as the Brazil-site domain interface between local corporate function leads and the client's global Digital Corporate platform team (Corporate Orchestration, ERP COE, Corporate Data Products & AI Adoption).
  • Validate ERP and platform configurations — SAP S/4HANA Finance, SuccessFactors, SAP GRC, and relevant ERP COE modules (CE SAP, SAP COE, Finance Core Systems, HR & Other HQ Core Systems) — against Brazilian statutory reporting (eSocial, SPED), tax, and labour requirements.
  • Guide local input into Brand Management, Communications & CSR and Strategy & Portfolio Management workstreams where they touch the Brazil site.
  • Represent the Brazil site's Digital Corporate perspective in programme governance, including sessions with the client's global Digital Corporate leadership.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 8+ years in corporate function roles or consulting across Finance, HR, Legal/Compliance or Property Management, with significant ERP or digital platform transformation experience in a Brazil-based or Brazilian-regulated entity.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SuccessFactors, SAP GRC, or equivalent corporate platforms, ideally including exposure to a manufacturing-oriented ERP COE (SAP COE / CE SAP or comparable plant-linked finance systems).
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian statutory and compliance obligations relevant to corporate digitalisation — eSocial, SPED, local tax reporting, and CSRD/ESG-equivalent sustainability reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese (native or C1+) AND professional English — all local stakeholder engagement, workshops and escalations will be conducted in both languages.
  • Demonstrable experience as a domain SME or senior business analyst on a large ERP or corporate transformation programme.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in corporate functions within a commercial vehicle, truck, or industrial manufacturing group operating in the Curitiba / Paraná region.
  • Exposure to Brand Management, Communications, or CSR digitalisation alongside core Finance/HR/Legal scope.
  • Familiarity with Corporate Data Products & AI Adoption initiatives and how they intersect with corporate reporting.

At HCLTech, we don't just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Regional Sales Representative — Campinas, São Paulo

Department: Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity

Location: Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel

Employment Type: Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)

Reports To: Head of Sales LATAM

Role Context

We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. São Paulo, anchored in Campinas, is part of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).

What You'll Do

  • Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in São Paulo, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.
  • Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across São Paulo.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.
  • Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).
  • Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.
  • Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.
  • Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.

What We Expect

Farm and Grow the Existing Base

  • Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in São Paulo, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio.
  • Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact.
  • Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact.
  • Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.

Grow — Bring In New Accounts

  • Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results.
  • Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio.
  • Establish Acceleronix's active presence in São Paulo — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.

Requirements

Required

  • Based in Campinas, São Paulo, or willing to relocate to the region.
  • Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.
  • Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline.
  • Availability for frequent travel within the region.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.
  • Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.
  • Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in São Paulo.
  • Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.

About Acceleronix

Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.

Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: HR Manager, Brazil
description:
What you'll do

As the HR Manager for Brazil, you will support ANTA Group's business expansion in Brazil by providing hands-on HR support and managing day-to-day local HR operations. You will work closely with business leaders to support store openings, recruitment, compensation, employee relations, and other local HR matters, helping establish a practical and compliant HR foundation as the business grows.

In this role, you will:

  • Support the launch and expansion of ANTA's business in Brazil, including HR-related preparation and execution for new store openings and other business initiatives.
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment for local teams, including store employees and corporate roles, and ensure timely hiring to support business growth.
  • Manage local compensation and benefits matters, including salary benchmarking, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and other employee-related payments.
  • Handle day-to-day employee relations and HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employee records, leave, attendance, and other local HR matters.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian employment requirements and support the management of local labor, visa/work permit, and employment-related matters.
  • Work closely with business leaders and external partners to solve practical HR issues and ensure smooth local operations.
  • Support the development and implementation of local HR policies, processes, and systems as the business grows.
  • Maintain accurate HR data and provide regular headcount, recruitment, compensation, and other HR reports.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • 5+ years of HR experience, with solid experience in HR generalist, HR operations, or HRBP roles.
  • Strong familiarity with the Brazilian local market, employment practices, and HR operations; experience working independently in Brazil is highly preferred.
  • Experience in retail, consumer, apparel, footwear, or other multi-site / store-based businesses is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience in recruitment, compensation & benefits, employee relations, and day-to-day HR operations.
  • Experience supporting new store openings, business expansion, organizational setup, or other fast-growing business environments is a strong plus.
  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle practical HR matters independently and work in a fast-changing environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with local employees, business leaders, and external partners.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese is required. Mandarin Chinese is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian employment law and local HR practices is required.

Travel

This role is based in Brazil and may require occasional travel within Brazil and to ANTA Group's global headquarters based on business needs.

The purpose of the role is to create exceptional architectural solution design and thought leadership and enable delivery teams to provide exceptional client engagement and satisfaction.

    • Collaborating with sales, program/project, consulting teams to reconcile solutions to architecture

    • Provides technical and strategic input during the project planning phase in the form of technical architectural designs and recommendations
    • Collaborates with all relevant parties in order to review the objectives and constraints of solutions and determine conformance with the Enterprise Architecture
    • Identifies implementation risks and potential impacts
  • 2. Enable Delivery Teams by providing optimal delivery solutions/ frameworks
    • Build and maintain relationships with executives, technical leaders, product owners, peer architects and other stakeholders to become a trusted advisor
    • Develops and establishes relevant technical, business process and overall support metrics (KPI/SLA) to drive results
    • Manages multiple projects and accurately reports the status of all major assignments while adhering to all project management standards
    • Identify technical, process, structural risks and prepare a risk mitigation plan for all the projects
    • Ensure quality assurance of all the architecture or design decisions and provide technical mitigation support to the delivery teams
    • Recommend tools for reuse, automation for improved productivity and reduced cycle times
    • Leads the development and maintenance of enterprise framework and related artefacts
    • Develops trust and builds effective working relationships through respectful, collaborative engagement across individual product teams
    • Ensures architecture principles and standards are consistently applied to all the projects
    • Ensure optimal Client Engagement
      • Support pre-sales team while presenting the entire solution design and its principles to the client
      • Negotiate, manage and coordinate with the client teams to ensure all requirements are met and create an impact of solution proposed

  • 3. Competency Building and Branding
    • Ensure completion of necessary trainings and certifications
    • Develop Proof of Concepts (POCs), case studies, demos etc. for new growth areas based on market and customer research
    • Develop and present a point of view of Wipro on solution design and architect by writing white papers, blogs etc.
    • Attain market referencability and recognition through highest analyst rankings, client testimonials and partner credits
    • Be the voice of Wipro’s Thought Leadership by speaking in forums (internal and external)
    • Mentor developers, designers and Junior architects in the project for their further career development and enhancement
    • Contribute to the architecture practice by conducting selection interviews etc
  • 4. Team Management
    • Resourcing
      • Anticipating new talent requirements as per the market/ industry trends or client requirements
      • Hire adequate and right resources for the team
    • Talent Management
      • Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability & effectiveness
      • Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
      • Manage team attrition
      • Drive diversity in leadership positions
    • Performance Management
      • Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
      • Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
    • Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
      • Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
      • Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team

Experience: 8-10 Years

title: Creative Director | Talent Pool
description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.

Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

  1. Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.
  2. Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.
  3. Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.
  4. Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.
  5. Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.
  6. Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.
  7. Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.
  8. Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.

MUST HAVE:

  • Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.
  • Positive leadership qualities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).
  • Fluency in English.

Sobre a UEX

Somos Nerds e Empreendedores!

A UEX é um estúdio de tecnologia, que opera no modelo de Startup Studio. Uma empresa de tecnologia, especialista em desenvolvimento, lançamento e operação de produtos e plataformas digitais.

COMO VOCÊ VAI CRIAR DRAGÕES?

Como Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) aqui na UEX você será responsável por provisionar e manter recursos em cloud, apoiar a criação/atualização de ambientes de projeto, implementar soluções de observabilidade e administrar credenciais e plataformas corporativas.

Está é uma posição Presencial, perfeita para quem Curitiba e região. Regime PJ ou Cooperado, além disso o processo seletivo é conduzido remotamente. Caso seja necessário um encontro presencial, nós avisaremos com antecedência para combinar a melhor data.

Requisitos

Você será responsável por:

  • Provisionar e manter recursos em cloud (VMs, bancos de dados, CDNs, storage, balanceadores e redes).
  • Garantir governança de tags, manutenção preventiva/corretiva e segurança básica do ambiente (hardening, MFA/IAM, backups, patches, criptografia, firewall/WAF).
  • Realizar gestão de custos (FinOps básico), incluindo budgets, rightsizing, reserved/savings plans e otimização de uso.
  • Automatizar provisionamento e rotinas de operação com IaC (Terraform/Ansible) e runbooks documentados.
  • Dar suporte a projetos, provisionando infraestrutura em diferentes estágios (dev/test/homolog/produção) e conduzindo upgrades/migrações com mínima indisponibilidade.
  • Colaborar com os times de desenvolvimento para viabilizar deploys, pipelines e boas práticas de confiabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter observabilidade, configurando Zabbix (dashboards, itens, gatilhos, templates) e New Relic (agentes, APM, alert policies e notificações), além de definir SLOs/SLIs e alertas acionáveis.
  • Administrar plataformas corporativas como Microsoft 365 (credenciais, licenças, grupos e políticas básicas de segurança), Azure DevOps (usuários, repositórios, pipelines e permissões), redes (UniFi/OpenVPN, VLANs, troubleshooting) e Proxmox (containers LXC, rede, quotas, backup/restore e monitoramento).

Para Ter Sucesso Nessa Posição, Você Precisa Ter

  • Experiência sólida com cloud computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Conhecimentos em automação/IaC (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Zabbix, New Relic ou equivalentes).
  • Noções de FinOps e otimização de custos em cloud.
  • Familiaridade com administração de Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, redes e Proxmox.
  • Visão crítica para propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos em soluções práticas e sustentáveis.
  • Autonomia e organização para lidar com múltiplos ambientes.
  • Espírito colaborativo para trabalhar próximo aos times de desenvolvimento e produto.

Se você é apaixonado por desafios, criatividade e deseja fazer parte de um ambiente onde sua contribuição é valorizada e incentivada, venha se juntar a nós!

PROCESSO SELETIVO

No processo seletivo da UEX, você passará por uma série de etapas que visam identificar e valorizar os melhores talentos para integrar nossa equipe.

Nosso time trabalha de forma presencial no nosso escritório em Pinheiros, São Paulo.

A Tako tem talento de big tech e autonomia de startup. Aqui, você entrará em um ambiente acelerado e de alto crescimento, focado na construção de um produto inovador que está revolucionando um nicho de poucas e antigas soluções.

Ownership, excelência e criatividade são primordiais do nosso ambiente, onde cada pessoa tem autonomia e responsabilidade por seu trabalho.

Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements.

  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship experience, with the ability to guide junior legal professionals.

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação:

Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper‑V;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

description:
Senior Software Engineer (Go)

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer - (Go) role at Block Labs.

About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming. We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi‑agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high‑frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

About The Role

We are developing a multi‑tenant Cashier‑as‑a‑Service platform, purpose‑built for crypto. This platform provides a unified backend for managing deposits, withdrawals, balances, and settlements across multiple tenants, from exchanges and payment providers to decentralized apps. You’ll be joining a senior, highly technical team building greenfield backend services at the core of a secure, high‑throughput financial platform. We value autonomy, craftsmanship, and long‑term thinking, and we’re building systems designed for resilience, transparency, and scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build distributed backend services that power a multi‑tenant cashier and transaction management system.
  • Develop core platform features for wallet orchestration, payment routing, reconciliation, and tenant onboarding.
  • Integrate with blockchain networks, payment gateways, and third‑party crypto APIs.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, end‑to‑end systems.
  • Contribute to architectural design and drive technical decisions across services.
  • Ensure scalability, fault‑tolerance, and compliance within a regulated financial context.
  • Maintain clean, testable, and well‑documented Go code following industry best practices.

About You

  • 6+ years of experience in backend development, ideally in high‑throughput or financial systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Go as a primary backend language; experience with gRPC and RESTful APIs is highly valued.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, multi‑tenant architectures, and microservices.
  • Experience with blockchain integrations, crypto custody, or payment rails is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working in cloud‑native environments.
  • Deep commitment to software reliability, observability, and security best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cryptographic key management, wallet abstractions, or transaction signing flows.
  • Background in fintech, DeFi, or crypto exchange infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven systems, Kafka, or message queues.
  • Prior experience designing APIs for multi‑tenant or white‑label products.

Culture

Mature, mission‑driven, and low‑ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

Sobre a Zippi

A Zippi tem como missão ajudar a impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito , permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa mais saudável para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, alcançamos a lucratividade e experimentamos um crescimento exponencial . Hoje, processamos mais de R$ 3,4 bilhões em pagamentos por ano e estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de crédito no mercado brasileiro de MPEs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 1,6 trilhão ao ano. title: Mobile Engineer (Remote)
description:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

As part of Fireblocks, Dynamic represents the next evolution of non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Dynamic is Fireblocks’ embedded wallet platform, purpose-built for developers who want to bring crypto and stablecoin experiences into modern applications without complexity. Together, Fireblocks and Dynamic are building the most complete, secure, and developer-friendly wallet infrastructure in the industry by combining institutional-grade security with consumer-grade experiences.

About the Team

Dynamic was founded in 2021 with a simple vision: every app and website will have a wallet component. That vision is rapidly becoming reality. Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.

Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.

As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks’ core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Engineers at Dynamic build secure‑by‑default systems and approach their work with a strong customer focus, balancing technical excellence with real-world user needs. You will be joining a passionate group that moves fast, works with the biggest names in payments and fintech, and is defining how the next generation of financial applications are built.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.
  • Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.
  • Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.
  • Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.
  • Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.
  • Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.
  • Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.
  • Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands‑on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production‑grade SDKs.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high‑quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross‑platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.
  • Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long‑term maintenance across platforms.
  • Experience with blockchain‑enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on‑chain interactions.
  • Experience working on security‑sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.
  • Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.
  • A get‑things‑done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Comfortable making long‑term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone.

Big Advantages

  • Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross‑platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.
  • Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.
  • Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low‑level crypto).
  • Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.

Ambiente colaborativo trabalhando em tarefas interessantes, juntamente com oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal & de carreira.

description:
Coordenador Engenharia de Software | Aceitação PJ

Sobre o PicPay

Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop. Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Sobre a Vaga

O Tech Manager é a ponte que une o produto com a parte técnica visando a entrega e acompanhamento dos projetos, provendo a robustez necessária para que tenhamos escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança para suportar milhares de clientes navegando em nossas plataformas. Sua principal missão é garantir que as ações técnicas se encaixem com as ações globais e vice versa, garantindo que estão sendo tomadas as melhores decisões para o produto no que diz respeito aos sistemas e a arquitetura de infraestrutura. Também é uma de suas missões, dimensionar tamanho e necessidades da equipe, identificando e removendo os impedimentos que não estão ao alcance do próprio time resolver, garantindo visibilidade para dentro e para fora do Squad. Além disso, é a pessoa que faz a gestão do dia a dia dos desenvolvedores da Squad que atua sendo referência para assuntos como: banco de horas, férias, engajamento e clima, dúvidas do dia a dia e feedbacks situacionais, essas decisões devem ser baseadas em dados e métricas tiradas do time e das pessoas.

Responsabilidade e atribuições :

  • Capacidade de planejamento e organização;
  • Visão analítica e questionadora;
  • Perfil estratégico baseado em métricas;
  • Habilidade em negociar e interagir com diversas áreas;
  • Facilidade em atuar de forma ativa na resolução de problemas e de conflitos;
  • Vivência em liderança técnica e de gestão de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento de ferramental de gestão e de visibilidade;
  • Experiência com frameworks ágeis (kanban, scrum);

Requisitos e qualificações :

  • Vivencia em ambientes transacionais ou de e-commerce;
  • Visão de produto e métricas de negócio;
  • Gestão de pessoas;
  • Gestão de times de Desenvolvimento;
  • APIs, Gateways, Aplicativos Mobile;
  • Microserviços e Containers;
  • Conhecimento em Kotlin, Java, Clouds(AWS, Azure, GCP), Brokers de Mensageria;
  • Observabilidade de Sistemas, CI/CD;
  • Ambiente de grande escala;
  • Métricas e projeções (leadtime, throughput, burnup);
  • Arquitetura de Event Streaming;
  • Relação com parceiros externos e interno;

O que oferecemos :

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • Wellhub.

Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho :

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade :

title: Gestor de Incidentes
description:
QUEM SOMOS:

Você é um apaixonado por negócios e Tecnologia e está em busca de novos desafios?Então, a BMP é o seu lugar ! Estamos crescendo cada dia mais e buscando pessoas com espírito de liderança, criativas e atentas à inovação para fazer parte do nosso time. Se você está pronto para fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, confira os requisitos para a vaga de Product Owner.

Sobre a BMP

Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.

Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil , com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.

Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):

Coordenação do Processo de Gestão de Incidentes

  • Assegurar que todos os incidentes sejam identificados, classificados, priorizados e tratados conforme a política
  • Receber notificações, avaliar informações iniciais e direcionar as ações às equipes competentes (TI, NOC, SOC, segurança, negócio).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das etapas formais: notificação, classificação (incluindo NISI), planejamento de ação, execução, registro (RISI) e encerramento.

Comunicação Corporativa de Incidentes

  • Definir e operar um plano de comunicação claro , adequado à severidade:
    • Comunicação simples para incidentes de baixa criticidade;
    • Comunicação estruturada para incidentes médios e altos;
    • Comunicação imediata para Diretoria, Jurídico, áreas de negócio e parceiros críticos nos incidentes graves.
  • Garantir consistência e precisão nas informações compartilhadas.

Integração com Mudanças e Problemas (ITIL/COBIT)

  • Coordenar identificação de mudanças necessárias decorrentes de incidentes críticos ou recorrentes.
  • Apoiar abertura de problemas , especialmente quando houver causa raiz não compreendida ou reincidência.
  • Integrar os três ciclos (Incidentes–Problemas–Mudanças) para:
    • Prevenir reincidências;
    • Garantir implementações em janelas seguras (finais de semana/horários restritos);
    • Incorporar aprendizados no catálogo de mudanças e melhorias.

Governança e Post Mortem

  • Conduzir ou coordenar análises pós-incidente (post mortem) para incidentes de criticidade alta.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos consolidando causas, impacto, falhas de processo, gaps de controles e recomendações.
  • Propor ações preventivas e corretivas ao Comitê de Segurança e às diretorias.

Atividades‑Chave da Posição

  1. Centralizar a gestão de incidentes em um único ponto de coordenação.
  2. Garantir que incidentes sejam tratados dentro dos SLAs definidos , com escalonamento adequado.
  3. Manter rotinas regulares com NOC/SOC para correlação, investigação e priorização de eventos.
  4. Construir dashboards executivos (status, tendências, tempos de resposta, severidade, reincidência).
  5. Estabelecer critérios claros de severidade , fundamentados em impacto ao negócio, clientes e requisitos regulatórios.
  6. Gerenciar incidentes de segurança , respeitando procedimentos de cadeia de custódia, privacidade e sigilo.
  7. Acionar comitês e lideranças conforme classificação e natureza do incidente .

Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):

  • Domínio de práticas ITIL (principalmente Incident, Problem e Change Management).
  • Conhecimento das políticas de segurança da informação e continuidade de negócios.
  • Capacidade de analisar logs, eventos, evidências e correlações de NOC/SOC.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SIEM, gestão de incidentes, monitoramento e governança.

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo 100% presencial, na Av Paulista;
  • Jornada de 2ª a 6ª - das 9h às 18h.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • VR Flex no valor de R$45,00;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Propay - Programa de Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Convênio com a FIAP (descontos para cursos de graduação, Pós e MBA em tecnologia);
  • Escola BMP (cursos gratuitos nas áreas de comunicação, financeira, tecnologia e outras);
  • Programa Construindo o Futuro;
  • Gratificações anuais.

description:
Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Trabalhamos com os nossos membros e parceiros para tornar as cadeias de valor um motor de prosperidade para comunidades e ecossistemas, operando diretamente nos territórios. Vemos um mundo no qual as florestas são uma fonte ilimitada de materiais e um lar para a biodiversidade, as comunidades têm direitos respeitados e oportunidades de se desenvolver, os trabalhadores são parceiros produtivos, e a agricultura se torna o instrumento para alimentar um planeta faminto e manter o clima estável.

Sobre o Projeto Carbono

Localizado na Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA), tem o objetivo de implementar práticas de baixo carbono, na cadeia de produção de óleo de palma de uma empresa local. Por meio de uma abordagem de ambientação climática, visa a gerar reduções e remoções de carbono por meio de quatro intervenções principais: (i) Estabelecimento de Sistemas Agroflorestais (SAFs), (ii) Restauração de áreas degradadas, (iii) Plantio de cultivo intercalar de cacau e palmeira, (iv) Transição para fertilizantes de base orgânica.

Como Gerente de Projetos, você será o(a) principal responsável por:

  • O Gerente de Projeto em Agricultura Regenerativa será responsável pelo planejamento e execução do Plano de Trabalho alinhado à estratégia de Landscape da microrregião de Tomé-Açu, incluindo gestão orçamentária e entrega de metas.
  • Além disso, o(a) gerente será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de diagnósticos, linhas de base e relatórios técnicos, bem como pela liderança na implementação de projetos de agricultura regenerativa, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidas. Também atuará na facilitação de capacitações para as equipes da Earthworm Foundation e parceiros, apoiando agricultores na adoção de práticas como sistemas agroflorestais (SAFs) e fertilização orgânica, com foco na redução e remoção de carbono.
  • Sob a supervisão do Líder de Campo, o gerente atuará como principal ponto de contato com parceiros do projeto , incluindo empresas e agricultores, promovendo engajamento contínuo e comunicação clara entre as partes.
  • O(a) gerente também será responsável por organizar visitas técnicas, workshops e eventos de campo, oferecendo suporte logístico e administrativo. Caberá ainda o monitoramento do progresso do projeto por meio da análise de dados, elaboração de relatórios periódicos e sistematização de aprendizados. Espera-se a entrega de estratégias, projetos e protocolos internos desenvolvidos, além da capacitação das equipes e da atuação dos agricultores com práticas regenerativas conforme o planejado.

Condições de trabalho

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciências Agrárias, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: Mínima de 3 anos
  • Idioma(s): Português e Inglês/Espanhol
  • Contrato temporário: 1 ano – Regime CLT (44 horas semanais)
  • Local: Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA

Você tem as características que buscamos? Confira:

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa e comprometida com resultados, para atuar na cadeia de suprimentos de óleo de palma em Tomé-Açu (PA), com foco na redução de carbono e práticas agrícolas sustentáveis. É importante ter boa comunicação e engajamento com stakeholders, contribuindo para a regeneração de paisagens e a sustentabilidade da região.

Experiência com agricultura sustentável, agroflorestas, fertilização orgânica, restauração de ecossistemas e conhecimento em geoprocessamento são diferenciais. Também valorizamos habilidades de liderança para apoiar agricultores na adoção de práticas de baixo carbono e paixão por agricultura regenerativa.

Se está procurando um propósito e deseja inovar e agir pelo meio ambiente, esta oportunidade é para você! Na Earthworm Foundation , você se juntará a uma equipe comprometida e apaixonada, focada em encontrar soluções concretas. E também descobrirá diversas personalidades, todas determinadas a regenerar ecossistemas.

Se tem interesse nessa aventura, inscreva-se enviando o seu Currículo para nossa equipe no Brasil, aos cuidados de Raquel Costa – - 24/06/2025 , com o assunto "Regenerative Agriculture Manager – 2025".

description:

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Research and Development Manager role at InPlanet

Direct message the job poster from InPlanet

Head of People @ InPlanet | the-ROCK-IT | Brazil | Climate | Art x Science

About InPlanet

REMOTE WITHIN BRAZIL (ideally SP)

Fluency in English and Portuguese both written and oral

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.

People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

As our Senior Research and Development (R+D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as addressing fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead on our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the Head of Science and Research (Christina), you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will manage and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead (Phil).

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planing our R+D programme such as design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields
  • You have, ideally, 5+ years experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, ideally with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g. from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of geology, geochemistry and weathering processes
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil

Key Qualities

  • You are a thought-leader and able to breakdown complex topics and present them in a clear and concise way
  • You are independent, confident, hands-on, a go-getter, full of energy and possess an exceptional drive
  • You are a fast learner and want to steadily improve your professional and personal skill set
  • You are a team player, willing to work with and support others in the team where necessary including actively volunteering for tasks to assist where appropriate

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Industry (CDR) and management experience is a real plus
  • You are **based near Piracicaba (SP) or happy to relocate
  • Experience with OKR goal setting

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay & travel!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilise geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognising the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)

(optional third interview)

  • Offer

Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Senior Electrical Cabin Systems Engineer
description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Position Overview

Boeing Brazil is seeking a Senior Electrical Cabin Systems Engineer , reporting to the Electrical and Electronics Engineering Manager, working out of the São José Dos Campos office.

The Senior Electrical Cabin Systems Engineer will join the team to defining and integrating airplane electrical systems across our commercial fleet.

This position will be assigned to work with Cabin Systems Team which includes In Flight Entertainment, Cabin Services System, Cameras & Sensors, interior lighting, passenger address systems, seat back video and more.

All projects center on the translation of concepts and high-level requirements to specific architectures and operational specifications including the physical integration of electrical systems and components into our complex airplanes. Work with a worldwide supplier base to implement system hardware and software. Validate designs through both laboratory and airplane testing. Work with aircraft systems from initial concept through certification, delivery, and through their production life. We are continually evolving the state of the art in commercial air transport.

Position Responsibilities

  • Works with customers to develop and document complex electronic and electrical system requirements.
  • Analyzes and translates requirements into system, hardware and software designs and interface specifications.
  • Tests and validates to ensure system designs meet operational and functional requirements.
  • Monitors supplier performance to ensure system integration and compliance with requirements.
  • Solves problems concerning and provides other support of fielded hardware and software over the entire product lifecycle.
  • Research and interpret engineering data including drawing specs, CATIA/CAD models, installation plans and various maintenance procedures to develop systems requirements.
  • Researches specific technology advances for potential application to company business needs.

Work Arrangement

This position is hybrid/telecommuting. The selected candidate will be required to perform work onsite at one of the listed location options. This is at the hiring team’s discretion and could potentially change in the future.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills / Experience)

  • Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.
  • Must have a Bachelor Degree in Engineering.
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language.
  • Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA). Applicable to Brazilian, recent engineering graduates within 6 months and foreign engineers when the employer is willing visa sponsor.
  • Experience working in a professional environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Education/Experience)

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or computer Engineering.
  • Relevant experience within Electrical Systems hardware and software design.
  • In depth experience with system design and integration during an airplane development program.
  • In depth experience with equipment design, specification and tests, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g. RTCA DO-160).
  • In depth experience in Electrical design; including but not limited to Electrical Systems design, Wire Design, Electrical Equipment Installation and Wire Installation Design.
  • Experience with project management skills within a fast paced highly integrated environment.
  • Experience working with cross functional teams.
  • Experience within requirement verification and validation, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., V-model application on ARP-4754).
  • Experience with equipment and systems certification under regulatory authorities (e.g. FAA, EASA).

Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Additional Information

This requisition is for a locally hired position in Brazil. Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil. Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S. based payroll.

Please also submit a CV or resume written in English.

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until Feb. 07, 2026 .

Export Control Requirements

This is not an Export Control position.

Education

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

Visa Sponsorship

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Shift

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

$45,000-$55,000

É uma Pessoa com Deficiência? Esta vaga também é para você!

Olá, somos o Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023) além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers, nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.

Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.

Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!

Nesta posição você será responsável pelo:

  • Acompanhar os afastamentos dos colaboradores por motivo de saúde, incluindo interface com temas previdenciários;
  • Fiscalizar as atividades relacionadas à Saúde do Trabalho junto aos órgãos competentes;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar o cumprimento dos requisitos legais em Saúde Ocupacional (Greenlegis, ISO 45001, JCI), em conjunto com a Coordenação da Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Apoiar a implementação e o acompanhamento de programas de saúde preventiva voltados aos colaboradores;
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de Saúde Ocupacional;
  • Participar de reuniões e projetos relacionados à área;
  • Gerir e integrar as ações e os processos de trabalho da Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Realizar a gestão da equipe de Enfermagem do Trabalho, Serviço Social, Terapia Ocupacional do Trabalho e Recepção, incluindo demandas operacionais como controle de ponto, férias e comunicação interna;
  • Apoiar as demais lideranças nas questões relacionadas à Saúde Ocupacional, Medicina Preventiva e legislação previdenciária.

Para esta posição é essencial ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Enfermagem, com COREN ativo;
  • Pós-graduação em Enfermagem do Trabalho;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de requisitos legais (Ius Natura, Greenlegis, entre outras);
  • Conhecimento em legislação previdenciária aplicada à saúde ocupacional (afastamentos, INSS, benefícios e interfaces legais);
  • Atuação com gestão de equipes;
  • Vivência em Saúde Ocupacional;
  • Diferencial, já ter atuado em ambiente hospitalar;
  • Perfil dinâmico, proativo e com boa capacidade de articulação.

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Horário: 08h às 17h

Indústrias e Meio Ambiente - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Recursos Naturais – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Conectividade e Produtos – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos.
